content.short: Cardano Sights is a series of digital art collections of the most iconic and inspirational places across the globe.
content.description:
Cardano Sights is a series of digital art collections which will consist of 999 landmark NFTs, all monumental to each place and its history. Each piece of art is unique. Landmarks give us a sense of place. These monuments and natural wonders connect us to a destination and inspire travel.

In Paris, it's the Eiffel Tower, and in New York City it's the Statue of Liberty. Explore the globe in search of these intriguing historic sights. The key goal of the project is to create a utility token which will allow everyone among the holders to participate in various events where the prize is fully paid trips to most breathtaking and iconic landmarks all over the globe.

Cardano Sights will be a fully community-driven project where people will be able to share their unforgettable experiences about the most unusual and breathtaking places all over the globe.
